pages.text: When one reaches a high enough stage in thier divine cultivation they unlock thier own personal divine realm. $(br2)In order to enter your realm you must reach a high enough stage and then click the Enter Realm button. $(br2)To bring other players into your realm you must a high enough stage and press the Pull Nearby button.

$(br2)When inside your divine realm you have a limited radius to build inside of which grows in size has you progress in your divine cultivation. $(br2)If you fall into the void or travel to far from your realm's center you will be pulled back to your realm's center.
